author: sonnet
label: c2-seed-sonnet-01
changes: Added a two-sentence-plus summary stating how it works today (history reload only) and why the outbox shape was chosen.

Added a Terms section defining Gateway, Message Service, Message Store, Outbox, Outbox Relay, Event Bus, Fan-out Worker, Presence Registry, Offline Inbox and Push Service, since the first version only named them.
Expanded the three-line component sketch into a numbered ASCII flow (send, fan-out, reconnect) with the error branch on the send path, as the brief requires.

Turned the one-line notes into numbered steps that each state trigger, action, where state lives and failure handling; merged the old notes (ack with seq, outbox, partitioning, presence TTL, 5 s timeout, push best effort, ordered sync, idempotent retries) into those steps and the shared rules.

Kept every first-version fact: ack with seq, outbox, bus partitioned by conversation, presence TTL with 10 s heartbeats, 30-day inbox expiry, 5 s timeout, best-effort push, seq-ordered sync, idempotent retries on msg_id, at-least-once with client dedupe.

Added brief facts missing from the first version: 30 s offline threshold, one device per user, 200-member cap, sender excluded, fan-out off the request path, ack only after commit, push never retried and never affects storage.
Added a failure table and a state-location rule; decided that an unreachable Presence Registry is treated as offline and an inbox write failure leaves the bus event unfinished.
Added a short Open questions section instead of inventing a mechanism for removing inbox entries after a late online ack.
